hook: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
hookText: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO

beats.say: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, just eleven days after his resignation, in a dramatic reversal at the world's most valuable chipmaker.

Shares of Nvidia closed up 31% following Huang's reinstatement. Huang and the board held their first conversations since his ouster on Saturday, and the group determined he would return as CEO during a second meeting on Sunday, the people said.
The stock had shed nearly 33% from the time Huang admitted to an extramarital affair on Nov.
